claim: Web Summit Lisbon runs 9 to 12 November.
Gol opens its first intercontinental route, Rio to Lisbon from Galeão, with five flights a week from 24 November.
Startups.com.br reported on 18 September 2026 that Invest.Rio and Maravalley had opened the call in September.
Startups.com.br named the ten startups on 26 October.
Correio da Manhã reported the same ten startups on 25 October.
Maravalley ran a mission to VivaTech in Paris in June 2026 with Business France's delegation.
Gol's flights from 24 November run on Mondays, Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Fridays and Saturdays.
The call was for startups under six years old with fewer than 100 employees.
Rio's mission is the second year; last year it also took ten startups to the summit.
